locator.section: Seventh Sunday after Pentecost, Secret body

entries.claim: Historical English basis of the prayer body, revised against the Latin in contemporary language. This locus abbreviates its conclusion as Through our Lord, &c.; it does not print the expanded ending.
The historical World without end supplies the basis for the contemporary duration formula forever and ever. This is a wording revision, not an exact quotation or spelling-only normalization.

locator.section: Libera nos, expanded conclusion before the duration response

entries.claim: Historical basis for the full conclusion, revised for the selected Latin: same is omitted and our is supplied for nostrum in the selected Latin; address and Holy Spirit terminology are modernized. This is a formula in Libera nos, not the Secret's abbreviated ending printed in full.
